test_list.description: A stream whose first non-whitespace character starts a one-line JSON object is StreamFormat::CargoJson.
Blank lines and indentation before the first JSON line do not matter.
A stderr `Compiling ...` line followed by JSON lines is StreamFormat::Mixed, not Text.
JSON lines followed by a text summary line are Mixed.
Empty and whitespace-only input is Text.
Text lines that merely contain or start a brace without being a one-line JSON object stay Text.
A UTF-16LE stream with BOM carrying JSON lines is detected as CargoJson.
proptest: detect_format returns for arbitrary bytes.

inputs.name: stream
inputs.description: Raw bytes piped from a compiler or linter.
